subject: Duplicate charge
text: I've been charged twice for the same £42.50 order at Halewood Books on 3 July. Please refund the second one.

subject: Payment I didn't make
text: There is a payment of £212.40 to Vertex Media on my statement. I have never heard of this company and did not authorise it.

subject: ABSOLUTELY FURIOUS
text: I am beyond angry. A charge of £89 has appeared from some company I've never dealt with. This is unacceptable and I want it dealt with TODAY.

subject: Wrong amount taken
text: The restaurant bill was £64 but £640 has come out of my account. Obviously a decimal error somewhere.

subject: Subscription still charging
text: I cancelled my gym membership in April but they have taken another £39.99 this month. Can you stop it and refund me?

subject: Hotel charged me twice
text: Booked one room, charged for two. The hotel says it's your side. £310 in total.

subject: Refund never arrived
text: The retailer confirmed a refund of £128 three weeks ago and it still hasn't reached my card.

subject: Query on a transaction
text: Could you tell me what the £17.99 to 'PP*DIGITAL' on 9 July is? I don't recognise it and I'd like it reversed if it isn't mine.

subject: Contactless used after loss
text: My card was in my coat which went missing on Saturday. There are four contactless payments after that I didn't make.

subject: Free trial charged
text: I signed up for a free trial and have been billed £59 without warning. I want this reversed.

subject: Currency conversion wrong
text: I paid 40 euros but was charged £48. The rate that day was nowhere near that.

subject: Two charges same second
text: Two identical charges of £23.10 from the same merchant, timestamped one second apart.

subject: Cancelled order still charged
text: The order was cancelled before dispatch but the money has still left my account.

subject: Disputed charge - polite
text: Good morning. I'm sorry to trouble you, but there's a charge for £75 I don't believe is mine. Could you look into it when you have a moment? Many thanks.

subject: ATM didn't dispense
text: The machine debited £200 but no cash came out. This was at the Kingsway branch on Tuesday.

subject: Balance transfer
text: How long does a balance transfer normally take, and should I keep paying the old card meanwhile?

subject: Interest question
text: If I clear my balance in full each month, do I pay any interest on purchases?

subject: Using card abroad
text: I'm travelling to Spain next month. What fees apply when I use the card there?

subject: Statement access
text: Where do I find my old statements in online banking? I need one from last year.

subject: Credit limit criteria
text: What do you look at when deciding whether to increase someone's credit limit?

subject: Direct debit timing
text: How long does it take for a new direct debit to become active?

subject: Dispute window
text: Just out of interest, how long do I have to dispute a transaction after it happens?

subject: Card delivery time
text: If a replacement card is ordered, roughly how long does it take to arrive?

subject: Annoyed but asking
text: Honestly your website is hopeless. Can you just tell me what the current APR is?

subject: Closing process
text: What's involved in closing an account? Not asking you to close it yet, just want to know.

subject: Cash withdrawal fees
text: Are there charges for withdrawing cash on a credit card at a UK machine?

subject: Minimum payment
text: How is the minimum payment on my statement calculated?

subject: Additional cardholder
text: Can I add my daughter as an additional cardholder, and what's the age limit?

subject: Fraud protection
text: What protection do I have if someone uses my card fraudulently?

subject: Paperless billing
text: Is there a way to stop receiving paper statements in the post?

subject: Change of address
text: I've moved to 14 Mill Lane, Leeds LS6 2AB. Please update the address on the card ending 6467.

subject: Lost card
text: I've lost my card somewhere between the office and home. Please block it and send a replacement.

subject: Statement copy
text: Could you post me copies of my statements for January to March please?

subject: Limit increase
text: I'd like to request an increase to my credit limit, from £3,000 to £5,000.

subject: Name change
text: I got married last month and need the name on my account updated to Sarah Okonkwo.

subject: Cancel direct debit
text: Please cancel the direct debit to Anytime Fitness on my account.

subject: Damaged card
text: The chip on my card has stopped working. Can you send out a new one?

subject: Close account
text: I'd like to close my account. The balance is cleared as of yesterday.

subject: Address change no detail
text: I have moved house. Please update my address on the card ending 6467.

subject: Travel notification
text: I'll be in Japan from the 3rd to the 20th. Please note it so my card isn't blocked.

subject: PIN reminder
text: I've forgotten my PIN. How do I get a reminder sent out?

subject: Phone number update
text: New mobile number for the account please, the old one is no longer in use.

subject: Paperless switch
text: Please switch me to paperless statements with immediate effect.

subject: Remove cardholder
text: I'd like to remove my ex-partner as an additional cardholder on the account.

subject: Payment date change
text: Can my monthly payment date be moved from the 1st to the 15th?

subject: Third time writing
text: This is the third time I have written. Nobody has actioned my request and I have now had a late payment letter. The service has been appalling.

subject: Bereavement ignored
text: My husband passed away in May and I asked you in June to move the account into my name. Nothing has happened and I am struggling to keep on top of this.

subject: Rude on the phone
text: The adviser I spoke to yesterday was dismissive and talked over me repeatedly. I want this looked into.

subject: Hardship ignored
text: I lost my job in April and told you I couldn't afford the payments. You've added charges anyway and I genuinely cannot cope with this.

subject: Promised callback
text: I was promised a callback within 24 hours. That was eight days ago. Nothing.

subject: Wrongly declined
text: My card was declined at a hospital car park even though I had plenty of available credit. Deeply embarrassing and I want an explanation.

subject: Ombudsman threat
text: I have got nowhere with three separate agents. If this is not resolved I will be going to the Financial Ombudsman.

subject: Complaint about a dispute
text: I raised a dispute six weeks ago and nobody has updated me once. That is not acceptable service.

subject: Hospital and no help
text: I have been in hospital for chemotherapy and asked for a payment holiday. I was told to call back, then cut off. Twice.

subject: Data error
text: You have my address wrong despite three corrections and my statements are going to a previous tenant. This is a serious data issue.

subject: Polite complaint
text: I don't like to make a fuss, but I have been let down repeatedly over the past two months and I feel I should say something formally.

subject: Charges after closure
text: I closed the account in May and you are still applying charges to it. I want a formal response.

subject: Carer struggling
text: I'm a full time carer for my mother and asked for help with the arrears. Nobody has come back to me and I'm at breaking point.

subject: Repeated failures
text: Four calls, three emails, two months. Still no resolution. I would like a formal complaint raised.

subject: Bereavement paperwork
text: I sent the death certificate for my late wife six weeks ago as instructed and have heard nothing at all since.

subject: Question
text: Hi, wondering about a charge on my account from last week, also could you send me a statement copy? Not sure who to ask.

subject: Help
text: Need help with my account please.

subject: Card
text: About the card.

subject: Not happy about a charge
text: There's a charge I'm not happy about and frankly the whole experience has been poor.

subject: Follow up
text: Following up on my previous message about the thing we discussed.
